gatherInputs.prompt: Job title you are applying for
One sentence describing your most relevant experience

draftLetter.prompt: Write a professional cover letter for a {job_title} position at {company}. The applicant has these skills: {skills}. Their most relevant experience: {experience}. The letter should be enthusiastic, concise, and under 300 words. End with 'Yours sincerely, [Name]'.

examples.question: Write a professional cover letter for a Software Engineer position at Stripe. Skills: TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL. Experience: Built a payments API handling 2M transactions per month at a fintech startup.
examples.answer:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Software Engineer position at Stripe. With hands-on experience building a payments API processing over 2 million transactions monthly, I understand the precision and reliability that financial infrastructure demands.

My core skills in TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL have been central to delivering this work — from designing schemas that handle concurrent writes safely to building developer-facing APIs that are both powerful and easy to integrate. I take particular pride in writing code that is maintainable and well-tested, because I know that in payments, edge cases are not optional.

Stripe's commitment to developer experience and its influence on how the internet handles money make this an opportunity I find genuinely exciting. I would love to bring my background to a team working at that scale.

Thank you for your consideration.

Yours sincerely, [Name]

humanReview.prompt: Review the draft above. Enter revision notes, or press Enter to accept

examples.question: Feedback: Add a mention of remote work experience and make it punchier. Draft: Dear Hiring Manager, I am writing to express my strong interest in the Software Engineer position at Stripe...
examples.answer:
Dear Hiring Manager,

Payments infrastructure should be invisible to users and bulletproof under the hood — that is the standard I have held myself to building APIs at scale. With TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL I delivered a payments system processing 2M monthly transactions, and did it fully remotely as part of a distributed team.

Stripe sets the bar for developer experience in fintech. I would like to help raise it further.

Thank you for your time.

Yours sincerely, [Name]
